chapter: Sam Morgan, repertoire and Silver Leaf
title: Buddy Petit and the violinist Joseph Welch
summary: He knew Buddy Petit and liked his playing, and recalls violinist Joseph Welch.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: No, that's right. You couldn't... What they did, what they did, they depended on the trumpet and the clarinet to carry this thing along. Yeah. Yeah. Talking about trumpet, do you remember Buddy Petit? Buddy Petit, yeah, I know him good, too.
Never did work with him, but I know him good. You liked his way of playing?

Oh yeah, I liked his way of playing, too, yeah. Was he more of a reader than you did? I don't think he was. I think he was more of a kind of player. But I know him good. Who was some of the violinists you used? Well, I tell you, it's kind of a hard matter, but you didn't fool the violin so much, it's kind of hard to remember that.
I can't remember. I can't remember right now.
His name was Welch, Joseph Welch, I don't know if you know him. I heard of him. He played with you. Joseph Welch, yeah, that's the only violin player, but I can think of him right now.
